author: Disney YouTube
text:
See how far Catherine Laga'aia & @MichelleKhare go on their road trip 🚗 Movie Surfers Moana out now
The Movie Surfers are back for another episode, with Disney’s Moana. Take a stroll down the beaches of Oahu with Dwayne Johnson (Maui) and learn what it means to bring his character of Maui to life in live action. Afterwards, Michelle Khare (@MichelleKhare) hops in the car for a road trip with Catherine Laga’aia (Moana) as they break down what it was like to step into the shoes of such a storied character and take a ride on Maui’s boat. Finally, the Surfers are joined by the movie’s choreographer, Tiana Liufau, to get a lesson in hula. 

Get your tickets now for Disney’s Moana, now playing only in theaters.
